Typefield for MacPrivate beta

Preparing the first download.

The current app build still needs Developer ID signing and notarization. The DMG will be available here for invited testers once that is complete.

We will link directly to the private GitHub release asset when it is ready.

Compatibility

macOS 13 or newer. Apple silicon.

Access

A GitHub account with access to the private Typefield repository is required for the beta download.

License

No Typefield account or license key is required for this beta build.

Once the DMG is ready

  1. Download it from this page while signed in to your invited GitHub account.
  2. Open the DMG and move Typefield to Applications.
  3. Open Typefield from Applications.
